newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: SOCCER-EX-MALTA COACH KOSANOVIC JOINS RED STAR BELGRADE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EX-MALTA COACH KOSANOVIC JOINS RED STAR BELGRADE.

text.p: Former Malta coach Milorad Kosanovic was named coach of Yugoslav club Red Star Belgrade, it was reported on Wednesday.
The Yugoslav news agency Tanjug said Kosanovic's two-year contract to coach the Maltese national team expired on June 8.
"I just arrived from Malta and will discuss details of my new job with Red Star director Dragan Dzajic tomorrow," Kosanovic said.

Red Star finished second in the national league this year behind city rivals Partizan, and will play in the European Cup Winners' Cup after beating Kosanovic's old club Vojvodina Novi Sad in the Yugoslav Cup final.
Kosanovic began his career as a player at Vojvodina, who he subsequently coached to the Yugoslav title before signing on with Malta.
